scope: Static review of the owner-scaling runner, workload failure coordination and workload auditor; final runtime/evidence acceptance remains separate.

closed_findings.finding: Offline build audit did not independently rederive accepted source identity, actual dependency closure or compiler invocation.
closed_findings.resolution: Hard-pinned D018/W2/toolchain/queue provenance; reconstructed exact historical compiler argv and .d closure, required selected profile headers/runtime, rejected shadowing and unsafe artifact paths.

closed_findings.finding: Per-group limits did not prevent repeated workload cases or omitted attempts.
closed_findings.resolution: Single canonical attempts-d018 ledger; exclusive case claim before process launch; consumed claims cannot be reused; final audit requires the exact 26 case claims and matching group/command/output identities.

closed_findings.finding: Unbounded child output and incomplete evidence reservations could exceed the 512 MiB evidence ceiling.
closed_findings.resolution: Child regular-file size capped at 8 MiB, core files disabled, per-command reservations include compiler artifacts and metadata margin, source copy sizes reserved, and JSON replacement writes check encoded size against the aggregate owned evidence budget.

closed_findings.finding: Queue provenance did not prove the 180-second outer bound or completed accepted-queue jobs.
closed_findings.resolution: Live authorization binds held default queue, W1 ancestry, exact runner/source identities and bounded request; final audit uses the frozen queue auditor and requires matching complete queue receipts.

closed_findings.finding: Timing wall_ns accepted finite floats and values outside uint64.
closed_findings.resolution: Non-null timing phase values now use strict uint64 validation.

closed_findings.finding: Lexical Path.absolute containment allowed a .. destination to escape counted output roots.
closed_findings.resolution: Repository roots and output destination resolved before containment; the same resolved destination is used for fresh output creation.

closed_findings.finding: The first live build reached successful timing compilation but rejected a lexical .. alias in the compiler dependency file.
closed_findings.resolution: dep_paths now applies os.path.abspath to each parsed dependency; raw .d files remain unchanged and executable clang++ driver spelling is preserved.

closed_findings.finding: The second live build reached successful timing compilation but rejected an SDK symlink spelling absent from the external catalog.
closed_findings.resolution: Live build records lexical dependency spelling to resolved identity aliases, catalogs accepted canonical aliases, and keeps raw .d bytes. Offline audit parses .d lexically and uses only frozen aliases/catalog/local artifact hashes, without resolving or reading the original SDK. Selected local headers cannot alias out of the frozen artifact.

harness_static_findings: No remaining blocking issue found in the four frozen controls: partial startup aborts before barrier entry and joins started workers; caught stage failures preserve phase rendezvous and subsequent free/destroy; coordinator verification runs while workers wait at the next barrier.

reviewer_execution.method: Source/log reads plus SHA-256 of the five listed local sources and comparison to the prepared-v5 source manifest; no workload, compiler or test execution.

limits: This is a source review, not native functional, diagnostic or sanitizer acceptance.
Actual include closure, all 26 workload outcomes, raw trace/ledger assertions, completed queue receipts and unchanged evidence still require final independent audit.
No formal timing or candidate authorization; diagnostic R256 and original F R8192 are distinct workload profiles.

additional_toolchain_capture.link_tools: System ld/otool wrappers and CLT ld/otool are hashed before and after build.
additional_toolchain_capture.driver: Executable /usr/local/bin/clang++ spelling remains unchanged; resolved identity is metadata only.
additional_toolchain_capture.acceptance: Actual compile/link success and matching native outcomes remain pending final evidence review.
